name: rs_input_barns

fields.name: status
fields.description: Lifecycle state. Required for new entity records; blank legacy rows are unclassified. Does not grant access or establish consent.

fields.name: record_mode
fields.description: Required for new records. Test records must never be used for live alerts. Blank existing values mean unclassified, not Live.

name: rs_input_subscriptions
description: User alert selections and consent state. No sending or automatic CRM synchronization is configured. Unknown consent never becomes Granted by migration. Minimum required: entity_uid, barn_uid, user_uid, engine_scope, target_type, target_uid, alert_types, status, consent_state, record_mode. User edits also retain owner/revision/request provenance where applicable. Field descriptions identify conditional requirements. UID relationships are application references, not Airtable-enforced foreign keys.

fields.name: entity_uid
fields.description: Required. Stable application UUID; preserve across CRM and Airtable. Do not use display names as identity.

fields.name: barn_uid
fields.description: Required. Barn scope for this subscription.

fields.name: user_uid
fields.description: Required. Recipient person from rs_input_users.entity_uid.

fields.name: engine_scope
fields.description: Required. One engine per subscription; engine rules stay separate.

fields.name: target_type
fields.description: Required. Defines which entity target_uid refers to.

fields.name: target_uid
fields.description: Required. Stable UID of the followed entity.

fields.name: alert_types
fields.description: Required before activation. Existing approved alert identifiers, one per line; no new trigger logic is defined here.

fields.name: phone_e164
fields.description: Required for active SMS. Normalized destination phone; never inferred from a name or phone suffix.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Required. Active additionally requires valid phone, Granted consent and source/time evidence; table storage alone does not enforce sending rules.

fields.name: consent_state
fields.description: Required. Record an actual user decision. Legacy active flags do not establish consent.

fields.name: consent_at
fields.description: Required when Granted or Revoked. Actual decision timestamp; do not fabricate migration timestamps.

fields.name: consent_source
fields.description: Required when Granted or Revoked. Form/event/source proving the decision.

fields.name: notice_version
fields.description: Required when the collection flow uses versioned notice text; preserve captured version.

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.description: Required after opt-out. Retain withdrawal; do not overwrite with stale CRM/mirror data.

fields.name: owner_uid
fields.description: Required on user-owned records. Existing application owner UID; not the Zoho staff Owner ID.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Required on user changes. Positive revision; used for optimistic concurrency.

fields.name: request_uid
fields.description: Required on user changes. Stable request ID for retry/idempotency.

fields.name: request_hash
fields.description: Required on user changes. Hash of the request body; do not store credentials.

fields.name: record_mode
fields.description: Required for new records. Test records must never be used for live alerts. Blank existing values mean unclassified, not Live.
